limitations: Same 80 coordinate plan for 2L and 4L is a controlled comparison, not two independently optimized complete layouts.
Only three decoupling VDD/VSS circuits and C16 bulk branches are routed; LDO 3V3 feed, HSE, USB, switch-mode power, analog and all other nets remain to route.
Ground plane is a real dynamic filled polygon with clearance holes and thermals; 4L L3 remains unpoured.
VSS-to-cap HF connection is on TOP with one cap-side ground via per group to the reference; graph reachability does not prove current direction or a mandatory plane path.
Native center-based neck is 1.3657mm <= local1.4; 0.6mm lies inside the pin pad and external neck is0.7657mm. The original global1mm was not claimed to cover the whole center-based segment.
Unknown actual component heights and unselected MPNs are not certified by default package height; root geometry review covers avoiding the restricted-height zone.
USB90ohm geometry/factory release, final assembly variant, thermal/current capacity, full-route return paths and EMI review remain subsequent engineering gates.
Film definitions remain exact to user templates; existing invalid references/filtering and missingREFDES silkscreen template issue are historical known boundaries, not production CAM certification.
No native GUI workflow, independent SI/PI waveform simulation, fabrication output CAM audit or board manufacturing release was performed.
